title: THE PIXEL UNDERCROFT FLOOR
why: Job 86b: the Undercroft floor in the pixel look: baked at one pixel per 2 world units from the same code and snapped to two 4 tone ramps, so the lift glow and the shadows fall in steps like the raid ground.
now: With the pixel look on (the default), the Undercroft floor is chunky pixel art in 8 stepped tones. With the look off, nothing changes.
